title: Meilisearch

tagline.en: Lightning-fast, typo-tolerant search engine with a simple REST API
tagline.es: Motor de búsqueda ultrarrápido y tolerante a errores tipográficos, con una API REST sencilla
tagline.de: Blitzschnelle, tippfehlertolerante Suchmaschine mit einfacher REST-API
tagline.fr: Moteur de recherche ultra-rapide et tolérant aux fautes de frappe, avec une API REST simple

notes: Meilisearch is an API, not a website: the site's HTTPS address is the endpoint your application talks to. The token shown on the first-run card is the master key (MEILI_MASTER_KEY, 32 characters); every request needs it, or a key made from it, in an Authorization: Bearer header.
Use the master key only to manage keys. Create scoped API keys with POST /keys (a search-only key for browsers, an admin key for your back end) and never put the master key in front-end code.

MEILI_ENV is production, so a master key is mandatory and the built-in search preview page is turned off: opening the address in a browser shows a JSON message, not a dashboard. Search from your own application, or from a client that sends a key.
Indexes and documents live in the data volume (/meili_data). The healthcheck calls GET /health with the curl that ships in the image. Anonymous telemetry is off (MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS).
The 512m floor covers small and medium indexes. Indexing large datasets uses more memory; raise the limit if indexing tasks fail or the container is killed.
